title: Fortresses in endings

D0.outcome: Explains a fortress as a set-up the stronger side cannot break despite its extra material.

D1.outcome: Told a material imbalance, builds the fortress and names the squares that must stay covered.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled endings, decides whether to aim for a fortress and spots one that cannot be broken.

D3.outcome: Tests a claimed fortress by naming the break and showing it fails, using the tablebase where possible.

conditions: Wrong-coloured bishop with a rook pawn: the defender's king reaching the corner holds the draw.
The stronger side has no entry square or breakthrough, and the weaker side keeps a safe waiting move.
condition_sources: CAP CI-14 (c); EDL K27 (b); MAP11 §4 verified
contrasts: One entry square is left uncovered.
The stronger side can force a zugzwang against the set-up.
A trivial exchange sacrifice that wins at once.

soft_prereq_notes.END.QUEEN-PAWN.D1: stalemate fortresses are often built against the queen
